data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella boat rental in May 2027? You're in for a treat. Spring along the Costa del Sol delivers near-perfect conditions: warm air temperatures averaging 22-26°C, calm seas with light westerly winds, and over nine hours of daily sunshine. Whether you're celebrating a birthday, hosting a corporate event, or simply escaping the UK chill, May offers the sweet spot between quiet spring and bustling summer. All our charters depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's iconic marina, and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. Below, we break down the weather, the best boats for May, and insider tips to make your day on the water unforgettable.

Why May 2027 Is Perfect for a Marbella Boat Rental

May sits at the intersection of spring warmth and summer readiness. The average high hits 26°C by mid-month, while sea temperatures reach 18°C—pleasant enough for swimming at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. Rainfall is minimal (just 20mm across the month), and the infamous Levante wind rarely blows hard. You'll enjoy glassy mornings and gentle afternoon breezes ideal for cruising along the Golden Mile or anchoring off Cabopino. Unlike July and August, the marinas are quieter, meaning less competition for prime spots and more attentive service from our skippers.

Best Boats for May Weather Conditions

May's stable conditions suit almost any vessel in our fleet. For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 (both €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours) offer nimble handling and open decks perfect for sunbathing. If you want space for up to 12 guests, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719 minimum 4 hours) includes a free jet ski—ideal for May's calm waters. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) provides shaded flybridge seating and a galley, great for longer days. For luxury, consider the Ferretti 94 (29m) or Canados 86 (26m); pricing is on request via WhatsApp. Every boat departs Puerto Banús and comes fully equipped with safety gear, insurance, and a professional skipper.

What to Expect: May Weather Data at a Glance

MetricMay Average
Air temperature (high)22-26°C
Sea temperature18°C
Sunshine hours/day9-10
Rainfall20 mm (2-3 days)
Wind speed5-10 knots (W/SW)
UV index7-8 (high)

These numbers mean you can comfortably sit on the bow without a jacket by 11 AM. Bring sunscreen and a light layer for the return leg as evening temperatures drop to 15-18°C. Our skippers monitor forecasts and adjust itineraries for maximum comfort.

Top Destinations for a May Charter from Puerto Banús

With May's mild winds, you can reach several highlights along the Costa del Sol. A 2-hour cruise takes you to Cabo Romano or the exclusive Río Verde beaches. Half-day trips (4 hours) stretch to Estepona or Cabopino, where you'll find quieter coves. Full-day charters (8 hours) can push to Sotogrande or even across the Strait of Gibraltar for a taste of Africa's coastline. Our skippers know the best spots for swimming, snorkelling, and dolphin watching—May often sees pods of common dolphins near the Bay of Marbella.

Pricing and Booking Tips for May 2027

Demand for Marbella boat rental in May is steady but not frantic. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are priced at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, with everything included. The Mangusta 80 requires a 4-hour minimum at €4,719, but you get a free jet ski—great value for groups wanting water sports. For other yachts like the Pershing 46 or Maiora 26m, contact us via WhatsApp for custom quotes. We recommend booking 2-3 weeks ahead, especially for weekends or the first week of May (Labour Day in Spain can fill slots). All bookings are confirmed with a deposit; balance is due 7 days before departure.

What's Included in Every Charter

No hidden extras. Every rental includes a licensed skipper (fluent in English and Spanish), fuel for the full itinerary, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava, plus light snacks like olives, crisps, and nuts. Insurance, safety equipment (life jackets, fire extinguisher, first aid), and Spanish IVA (21%) are all covered. You can bring your own food or arrange catering via our team. The only optional extras are premium catering, extra water toys, or a photographer—just ask when booking.
